hook.rumour: Beneath the giant emperor-crab shell of Skar in Ald'ruhn, Redoran guards whisper that ash-caravans from Gnisis and Maar Gan have found red-wax Sixth House bells hidden inside supply crates.
hook.notice: REDORAN COUNCIL PROCLAMATION AT ALD'RUHN — Outlanders and retainers summoned to investigate the Sleeper caches along the ash-road between Ald'ruhn, Maar Gan, and Kogoruhn.
hook.context: House Redoran's honor demands that Ald'ruhn hold the northern ash-marches against the blight, even while Archmaster Venim and Councilor Sarethi clash in the council chambers.

stages.objective: Receive your briefing from Councilor Sarethi's clerks beneath Skar in Ald'ruhn
Inspect the quarantined guar-sheds and shrine stones at Maar Gan
Question the Legion and Redoran patrol captains at Gnisis about the northern ash-tracks

objectives.text: Receive your briefing from Councilor Sarethi's clerks beneath Skar in Ald'ruhn
Inspect the quarantined guar-sheds and shrine stones at Maar Gan
Question the Legion and Redoran patrol captains at Gnisis about the northern ash-tracks

consequence_detail.summary: Inspections at Maar Gan and Gnisis trace the ash-salted crates to a Sixth House relay cell inside the Dunmer stronghold of Falasmaryon.

stages.objective: Muster with the Redoran outriders on the ridge at Bal Isra
Clear the Sleeper cell inside Falasmaryon and shatter their red-wax chime rack
Check the ancient propylon chamber at Andasreth for the cult's retreat route

objectives.text: Muster with the Redoran outriders on the ridge at Bal Isra
Clear the Sleeper cell inside Falasmaryon and shatter their red-wax chime rack
Check the ancient propylon chamber at Andasreth for the cult's retreat route

consequence_detail.summary: The chime rack at Falasmaryon is shattered, and tracks at Andasreth confirm an Ash-Priest is waking a blight-choir inside Kogoruhn.

stages.objective: Receive the pilgrim's ash-blessing at the Maar Gan shrine before crossing into the blight-wind
Enter the Sixth House citadel of Kogoruhn and slay the Ash-Priest of the Northern Choir
Deliver the captured Sixth House battle-plan to the garrison at Buckmoth Legion Fort

objectives.text: Receive the pilgrim's ash-blessing at the Maar Gan shrine before crossing into the blight-wind
Enter the Sixth House citadel of Kogoruhn and slay the Ash-Priest of the Northern Choir
Deliver the captured Sixth House battle-plan to the garrison at Buckmoth Legion Fort

consequence_detail.summary: The Ash-Priest in Kogoruhn is slain and the dream-transmissions plaguing Ald'ruhn and Maar Gan cease.

stages.objective: Lay the shattered Ash-Priest bell before the Redoran Council Hall inside Skar
Witness the Ashlander caravan-truce renewed at the western gate of Ald'ruhn
Receive the Helm-Salute of the Redoran Council in Ald'ruhn

objectives.text: Lay the shattered Ash-Priest bell before the Redoran Council Hall inside Skar
Witness the Ashlander caravan-truce renewed at the western gate of Ald'ruhn
Receive the Helm-Salute of the Redoran Council in Ald'ruhn

consequence_detail.summary: With Kogoruhn's northern choir silenced, Ald'ruhn's council unites behind the ash-road defense and reopens the Ashlander trade gate.
